In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], a '''New Republic pilot''' was given important intel about the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].

==Biography==
One week after the [[Battle of Helska IV|invasion]] of [[Helska IV]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], led by Boba Fett, [[Battle of Birgis|assaulted]] the spaceport on [[Birgis]]. Fett, [[Goran Beviin]] and [[Cham Detta]] spearheaded the assault. Fett hoped to use this moment to pass on vital intel to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. He passed the intel on to the pilot during the assault, telling her to give it to the New Republic.<ref name="Boba Fett: A Practical Man">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''</ref>
